label: rem:braid-lifting-compatibility
title: Compatibility with the lifting theorem
html: The jet prolongation preserves the braided monoidal structure. If \mathbf{C} is braided, the jet object J^1(A) = A \otimes \Omega^1(A) inherits a braiding from the tensor product of the braidings on A and \Omega^1(A). Consequently, the braid-group representations \rho_n at each level of the brane tower are compatible with the transition maps. The direct-limit algebra \mathcal{A}_\infty = \varinjlim\Gamma(J^1 \mathcal{S}_n, \mathrm{SU}_{q_n}(2)) thus carries a well-defined B_n-action for every n.
